description: Why: consecutive_failures drives the blacklist threshold; double-counting halves the effective threshold and causes premature blacklisting. What: peer_registry.rs record_rejected() increments consecutive_failures (capped at 20 via MIN in SQL), and blacklist.rs check_and_blacklist() also increments consecutive_failures atomically via UPDATE ... RETURNING. If both are called for the same rejection event (as the IHAVE/TAKETHIS rejection path suggests), the counter increments twice per event. Need to audit all call sites to determine if both are called for the same event.
title: Double-increment of consecutive_failures: peer_registry and blacklist both called per rejection
